openwrt_wiki.einleitung: lightweight proprietary (based on 802.11ac) outdoor access points with a 13, 16 or 19 dBi antenna covering 30º and a Passive POE Gigabit Ethernet port based on the AR9342 SoC
openwrt_wiki.hinweis_airmax: official firmware is not compatible to 802.11ac as Ubiquiti uses their own TDMA packet timing scheme ... With the OpenWrt firmware however, the device is normally 802.11ac compatible
openwrt_wiki.hardware_highlights_hinweis: The official data sheet list 8MB flash, but the bootlog really shows 16MB, even the OEM mtd table is using/assuming all 16MB
openwrt_wiki.installation: Flashing through factory firmware: siehe toh:ubiquiti:common#openwrt_installation_on_wa_and_xc_boards (Einzelschritte hier nicht übernommen)
openwrt_wiki.oeffnen: The NanoBeam AC devices seem to be ultrasonically welded together and thus cannot be opened. This makes any TTL serial recovery somewhat destructive.
openwrt_wiki.debricking: urescue aus U-Boot: Reset 20 s beim Einschalten halten, Signal-LEDs blinken abwechselnd, TFTP an 192.168.1.20 mit signierter Herstellerfirmware
